role: TileEntitySpecialRenderer for TileEntitySign: draws ModelSign (post for standing signs, wall-mounted otherwise) with sign.png, rotated by metadata, then draws the four text lines with the FontRenderer, highlighting the edited line with '> <'.
notes: Standing (the stick shown, the 16 rotations) and wall signs (four facings), the board and stick without GL_RESCALE_NORMAL (the 2/3 scale lengthens the normals, as vanilla lights them), and the four lines through FontRenderer's glyph strips in black with the depth mask off, the edited line wrapped in '> <'. Placed signs stay blank in this world (sign editing is off); te_signs sets the lines through the dev setblock's tile.
